cards.name: IVGStructColorConversionOptions
cards.summary: Color-management settings used when a file is opened, imported or pasted: the color management policy, the profiles to assume for the incoming data, the profiles to convert the document to, and an optional callback for missing or mismatched profiles. You never create it on its own; it hangs off the open, import and paste option structs.
use_for: placing client photos with no embedded profile into a CMYK print layout under a known source-profile assumption
batch-opening or importing files with one predictable color policy, without per-file mismatch prompts
pasting RGB artwork from other apps into a print document without surprise conversions
avoid: converting single colors: use IVGColor.ConvertTo
setting TargetColorProfileList on a shared or finished document: per the typelib it changes the color context of the whole document
cards.how: Options object of the VGCore model. There is no factory for it: a script reaches it read-only through the ColorConversionOptions property of IVGStructOpenOptions, IVGStructImportOptions or IVGStructPasteOptions (made with Application.CreateStructOpenOptions / CreateStructImportOptions / CreateStructPasteOptions). Set its members, then pass the parent struct to Application.OpenDocumentEx, Layer.ImportEx or Layer.PasteEx.

key_members.name: ColorPolicy
key_members.use: the color-management policy object for this open/import/paste (read-only reference; edit its own properties)

key_members.name: SourceColorProfileList
key_members.use: profile names to assume as the source of the incoming color data

key_members.name: TargetColorProfileList
key_members.use: profile names to convert the document to after the operation; changes the whole document's color context

key_members.name: ColorConversionHandler
key_members.use: custom callback object called when profiles are missing or mismatched

gotchas: ColorPolicy is read-only: change the policy object's properties, you cannot assign a different policy object.
TargetColorProfileList re-targets the color context of the whole document, not only the incoming objects (typelib description).
The string format of the profile lists (order of RGB / CMYK / grayscale entries, separator) is not documented in the typelib; read the current value and keep its shape (unverified).

ColorConversionHandler needs a COM object that implements IColorConversionHandler, which is awkward from Python / pywin32; leave it empty so the policy decides (unverified that it then never prompts).
Each parent struct has its own ColorConversionOptions: settings made on an import options object do not affect opening or pasting.
cards.example:
Dim io As StructImportOptions
Set io = Application.CreateStructImportOptions
Debug.Print io.ColorConversionOptions.SourceColorProfileList
Debug.Print io.ColorConversionOptions.TargetColorProfileList
ActiveLayer.ImportEx("C:\in\photo.jpg", cdrJPEG, io).Finish

cards.name: IVGStructCreateOptions
cards.summary: Settings for a new document made by script: name, page width and height, measurement units, rendering resolution, bleed and document color context. Passed to Application.CreateDocumentEx so the document starts at the right size instead of being created at the default page and resized.
use_for: A4 / A3 print posters and flyers created with a 3 mm bleed already set
1080 x 1080 px social post canvases in pixel units
batch-creating one document per job-ticket size
starting a print job in a known color context instead of the app default
avoid: resizing an existing document or adding pages of another size: change the page settings of that document instead
naming the output file: Name is only the document title, the file is written later with SaveAs
cards.how: Options object of the VGCore model. Application.CreateStructCreateOptions returns a fresh struct; fill its properties and pass it to Application.CreateDocumentEx(Options), which returns the new IVGDocument.

key_members.name: Name
key_members.use: title of the new document

key_members.name: Units
key_members.use: cdrUnit used for the page size and as the document's default unit

key_members.name: PageWidth
key_members.use: page width, in Units

key_members.name: PageHeight
key_members.use: page height, in Units

key_members.name: Bleed
key_members.use: page bleed of the new document

key_members.name: Resolution
key_members.use: document rendering resolution (typelib); dpi presumably (unverified)

key_members.name: ColorContext
key_members.use: IVGColorContext (color profiles) of the new document

gotchas: Set Units together with the sizes: PageWidth and PageHeight are read in Units (typelib), so 210 x 297 is A4 only with cdrMillimeter.
Bleed is probably read in Units as well (unverified).
Resolution is the document's rendering resolution, not an export dpi; exports take their own resolution from StructExportOptions.
If ColorContext is left empty the application's default color settings apply (unverified); build one with Application.CreateColorContext for a fixed profile set.
cards.example:
Dim co As StructCreateOptions, doc As Document
Set co = Application.CreateStructCreateOptions
co.Name = "A4 poster"
co.Units = cdrMillimeter
co.PageWidth = 210: co.PageHeight = 297
co.Bleed = 3: co.Resolution = 300
Set doc = Application.CreateDocumentEx(co)

review.changes: Resolution: dpi unit marked unverified (typelib gives no unit)

cards.name: IVGStructExportOptions
cards.summary: Bitmap export settings for Document.ExportEx: pixel size or resolution, color mode of the image, anti-aliasing, transparent background or matte color, dithering, compression, layer keeping, color profile use, overwrite and the area to export. It is how a script makes PNG, JPEG, TIFF and similar raster files from vector artwork.
use_for: exporting a logo selection as a 300 dpi transparent PNG
web and social images at an exact pixel size with anti-aliasing
TIFF or JPEG proofs of a page in RGB or CMYK
exporting only a rectangle of the page (ExportArea)
avoid: vector formats (PDF, SVG, EPS): use their own filter settings, these members are raster settings
8-bit paletted output on its own: the palette is set in IVGStructPaletteOptions, passed alongside
cards.how: Options object of the VGCore model. Application.CreateStructExportOptions returns a fresh struct; set its members and pass it as Options to ActiveDocument.ExportEx(FileName, Filter, Range, Options, PaletteOptions), which returns an export filter whose Finish writes the file. Document.ExportBitmap takes the same settings as plain arguments.

key_members.name: ImageType
key_members.use: color mode of the bitmap (cdrImageType: RGB, CMYK, grayscale, paletted ...)

key_members.name: ResolutionX
key_members.use: horizontal resolution in dpi

key_members.name: ResolutionY
key_members.use: vertical resolution in dpi

key_members.name: SizeX
key_members.use: output width in pixels

key_members.name: SizeY
key_members.use: output height in pixels

key_members.name: MaintainAspect
key_members.use: keep width / height ratio when only one size is given

key_members.name: AntiAliasingType
key_members.use: none, normal or supersampling edge smoothing

key_members.name: Transparent
key_members.use: transparent background where the format supports it

key_members.name: Matted
key_members.use: fill the background with a matte color

key_members.name: MatteColor
key_members.use: matte color (IVGColor object)

key_members.name: MatteMaskedOnly
key_members.use: apply the matte only to masked areas

key_members.name: Dithered
key_members.use: dither when reducing colors

key_members.name: Compression
key_members.use: compression type for formats that offer one (cdrCompressionType)

key_members.name: UseColorProfile
key_members.use: embed / apply the color profile

key_members.name: MaintainLayers
key_members.use: keep layers in formats that support them

key_members.name: ExportArea
key_members.use: rectangle (IVGRect) to export instead of the whole range

key_members.name: Overwrite
key_members.use: replace an existing file without asking

key_members.name: AlwaysOverprintBlack
key_members.use: overprint black during export

key_members.name: ProofColorSettings
key_members.use: color-proofing settings to apply on export

gotchas: Only ProofColorSettings has a typelib description; the meaning of the other members comes from the matching fields of the bitmap export dialog.
ExportEx returns an ICorelExportFilter; call Finish on it, otherwise the file may not be written (unverified for every filter).
SizeX / SizeY are pixels while ResolutionX / ResolutionY are dpi; set one pair deliberately, and leave the other for MaintainAspect / the app to derive (unverified which wins when both are set).
Transparent needs a format with alpha (PNG, TIFF); for JPEG use Matted + MatteColor for the background (unverified).
cdrExportRange only has cdrAllPages, cdrCurrentPage and cdrSelection; how ExportArea interacts with the Range argument is unverified.
MatteColor is an IVGColor object: set it with the color's own methods (e.g. RGBAssign) rather than assigning a number (unverified that a fresh struct already holds a color object).
cards.example:
Dim eo As StructExportOptions
Set eo = Application.CreateStructExportOptions
eo.ImageType = cdrRGBColorImage
eo.ResolutionX = 300: eo.ResolutionY = 300
eo.AntiAliasingType = cdrNormalAntiAliasing
eo.Transparent = True: eo.Overwrite = True
ActiveDocument.ExportEx("C:\out\logo.png", cdrPNG, cdrSelection, eo).Finish

cards.name: IVGStructFontProperties
cards.summary: Legacy bundle of character formatting for text: font name, style (weight / italic), size, underline, overscore and strikethrough lines, case (small caps / all caps), sub- or superscript position, range kerning, and the text's fill and outline. Its only routes in 25.1 are hidden members (Text.FontProperties / FontPropertiesInRange and Application.CreateStructFontProperties), so it is an old text model kept for compatibility.
use_for: reading or setting a whole headline's font, size, weight and case in one object in old macros
copying character formatting from one text object to another (read the struct from one, write it to the other)
auditing which fonts and sizes a document's text uses
avoid: new scripts: format text through IVGTextRange (Text.Story / Text.Range: Font, Size, Bold, Fill) instead of this hidden route
per-character formatting in long stories: walk IVGTextRange / IVGTextCharacters
cards.how: Old-style property struct of the VGCore text model. A script gets it from a text shape through the hidden IVGText members FontProperties(Frames) (whole frame chain, default cdrAllFrames) or FontPropertiesInRange(StartIndex, Count, IndexingType), or makes an empty one with the hidden Application.CreateStructFontProperties. Change members, then assign the struct back through the same Text property, which is 'get or set'.

key_members.name: Name
key_members.use: font family name

key_members.name: Style
key_members.use: weight / italic variant (cdrFontStyle: normal, bold, italic, thin, light, medium, semi-bold, extra-bold, heavy ...)

key_members.name: Size
key_members.use: font size

key_members.name: Underline
key_members.use: underline type (cdrFontLine)

key_members.name: Overscore
key_members.use: line above the text (cdrFontLine)

key_members.name: Strikethru
key_members.use: strikethrough line (cdrFontLine)

key_members.name: Uppercase
key_members.use: case: normal, small caps or all caps (cdrFontCase)

key_members.name: Position
key_members.use: normal, subscript or superscript (cdrFontPosition)

key_members.name: RangeKerning
key_members.use: tracking / range kerning of the characters

key_members.name: Fill
key_members.use: fill of the characters (IVGFill)

key_members.name: Outline
key_members.use: outline of the characters (IVGOutline)

gotchas: Every route to this struct is a hidden member in the 25.1 typelib (IVGText.FontProperties, FontPropertiesInRange, Application.CreateStructFontProperties): VBA IntelliSense does not list them and they may be removed in a later release.
None of the members have typelib descriptions.
Changing the struct alone probably does not change the text; write it back with Text.FontProperties(...) = struct (unverified).
A range with more than one value presumably reports the cdrMixed... value of the enum (cdrMixedFontStyle, cdrMixedFontLine, cdrMixedFontCase, cdrMixedFontPosition).
Size is most likely in points whatever the document unit, and RangeKerning units are undocumented (unverified).
cards.example:
Dim fp As StructFontProperties
Set fp = ActiveShape.Text.FontProperties(cdrAllFrames)
Debug.Print fp.Name, fp.Size, fp.Style
fp.Name = "Arial": fp.Size = 36
fp.Style = cdrBoldFontStyle
fp.Uppercase = cdrAllCapsFontCase
ActiveShape.Text.FontProperties(cdrAllFrames) = fp

review.changes: Style member: cdrFontStyle has no 'black' value; listed real ones (thin, medium, semi-bold, extra-bold, heavy); cdrMixed... gotcha marked as inference

cards.name: IVGStructHyphenationSettings
cards.summary: Legacy struct with the hyphenation settings of text: automatic hyphenation on or off, whether capitalised and all-caps words may break, the hot zone, the minimum word length and the minimum characters before and after a hyphen. Reached only through hidden IVGText members in 25.1.
use_for: justified body text in brochures and newsletters, to reduce gaps and rivers
narrow paragraph-text columns that otherwise rag badly
keeping brand names and acronyms unbroken (no breaks in capitalised or all-caps words)
avoid: artistic (single-line) text that never wraps: hyphenation has nothing to do there

new scripts: this route is hidden; set hyphenation on IVGTextRange (Text.Story / Text.Range): AutoHyphenate, HyphenHotZone, HyphenMinWordLength, HyphenMinCharsBefore, HyphenMinCharsAfter, HyphenateCapitals, HyphenateAllCapWords
cards.how: Old-style property struct of the VGCore text model. Get it with the hidden IVGText members HyphenationSettings(Frames) (default cdrAllFrames) or HyphenationSettingsInRange(StartIndex, Count, IndexingType), or an empty one from the hidden Application.CreateStructHyphenationSettings; change members and assign it back through the same property.

key_members.name: UseAutomaticHyphenation
key_members.use: turn automatic hyphenation on or off

key_members.name: BreakCapitalized
key_members.use: allow breaking words that start with a capital

key_members.name: BreakAllCapWords
key_members.use: allow breaking words set in all caps

key_members.name: HotZone
key_members.use: distance from the right edge inside which a word gets hyphenated

key_members.name: MinWordLength
key_members.use: shortest word that may be hyphenated

key_members.name: MinCharactersBefore
key_members.use: minimum characters left before the hyphen

key_members.name: MinCharactersAfter
key_members.use: minimum characters carried after the hyphen

gotchas: Every route to this struct is hidden in the 25.1 typelib (IVGText.HyphenationSettings, HyphenationSettingsInRange, Application.CreateStructHyphenationSettings).
None of the members have typelib descriptions; HotZone's unit is undocumented (document units are likely, unverified).
Hyphenation only shows in wrapping paragraph text, and needs the text's language to have hyphenation support (unverified).
Editing the struct alone probably does not reach the text; assign it back (unverified).
cards.example:
Dim hs As StructHyphenationSettings
Set hs = ActiveShape.Text.HyphenationSettings(cdrAllFrames)
hs.UseAutomaticHyphenation = True
hs.MinWordLength = 6
hs.MinCharactersBefore = 3: hs.MinCharactersAfter = 3
hs.BreakCapitalized = False
ActiveShape.Text.HyphenationSettings(cdrAllFrames) = hs

review.changes: avoid: the harvest lists the current IVGTextRange hyphenation members (AutoHyphenate, HyphenHotZone, HyphenMin*, HyphenateCapitals, HyphenateAllCapWords); named them instead of 'unverified which member'

cards.name: IVGStructImportOptions
cards.summary: Settings for Layer.ImportEx: how a bitmap comes in (embedded or linked externally, full, cropped or resampled, multi-layer bitmaps combined or kept as layers, ICC profile extracted, which image of a multi-image file), how text and tables come in (formatting, code page, tables as text, column delimiter, black text forced to CMYK black), watermark detection, OPI links, and the color conversion options.
use_for: placing a layered PSD into a layout with its layers kept
importing product photos linked externally so the CDR file stays small
bringing a Word / RTF text file in without its fonts and formatting
importing one page or frame of a multi-image file (ImageIndex)
cropping or resampling big camera images on the way in
avoid: opening a file as its own document: use Application.OpenDocumentEx with IVGStructOpenOptions
linked bitmaps for files that travel to a printer: links break when the source moves; embed instead
cards.how: Options object of the VGCore model. Application.CreateStructImportOptions returns a fresh struct; set members and pass it to ActiveLayer.ImportEx(FileName, Filter, Options), which returns an ICorelImportFilter; call Finish on it to place the content on that layer.

key_members.name: Mode
key_members.use: cdrImportFull, cdrImportCrop or cdrImportResample

key_members.name: LinkBitmapExternally
key_members.use: link the bitmap file instead of embedding it

key_members.name: MaintainLayers
key_members.use: keep the layers of a layered file

key_members.name: CombineMultilayerBitmaps
key_members.use: flatten a multi-layer bitmap into one image

key_members.name: ExtractICCProfile
key_members.use: read the embedded ICC profile

key_members.name: ImageIndex
key_members.use: which image / page of a multi-image file

key_members.name: CropLeft
key_members.use: crop rectangle left edge (Mode = cdrImportCrop)

key_members.name: CropTop
key_members.use: crop rectangle top edge

key_members.name: CropWidth
key_members.use: crop rectangle width

key_members.name: CropHeight
key_members.use: crop rectangle height

key_members.name: ResampleWidth
key_members.use: new width when resampling (Mode = cdrImportResample)

key_members.name: ResampleHeight
key_members.use: new height when resampling

key_members.name: ResampleDpiX
key_members.use: new horizontal resolution when resampling

key_members.name: ResampleDpiY
key_members.use: new vertical resolution when resampling

key_members.name: TextFormatting
key_members.use: keep fonts and formatting, drop formatting, or formatting only (cdrImportTextFormatting)

key_members.name: CodePage
key_members.use: code page for text files

key_members.name: ConvertTablesToText
key_members.use: turn imported tables into delimited text

key_members.name: TableColumnDelimiter
key_members.use: delimiter used when tables become text

key_members.name: ForceCMYKBlackText
key_members.use: make black text pure CMYK black

key_members.name: ColorConversionOptions
key_members.use: color-management settings for this import (read-only reference)

gotchas: Only ColorConversionOptions has a typelib description; the rest maps to the import dialog fields.
Crop* and Resample* values are presumably read only when Mode is cdrImportCrop / cdrImportResample, and they are longs, most likely source pixels (unverified).
ImportEx returns a filter; call Finish or nothing is placed (unverified for every filter).
TableOutline is a hidden member in 25.1; CropHandler, ResampleHandler and CustomData are callback / custom hooks that are hard to drive from Python.
The imported content lands on the given layer at a default position; move or align it afterwards (unverified where it lands).
ColorConversionOptions is read-only: set its members, do not assign another struct.
cards.example:
Dim io As StructImportOptions
Set io = Application.CreateStructImportOptions
io.Mode = cdrImportFull
io.MaintainLayers = True
io.LinkBitmapExternally = False
io.ExtractICCProfile = True
ActiveLayer.ImportEx("C:\in\product.psd", cdrPSD, io).Finish

cards.name: IVGStructOpenOptions
cards.summary: Settings for opening a document with Application.OpenDocumentEx: the code page for text in files from earlier CorelDRAW versions, and the color conversion options (policy, assumed source profiles, target profiles) applied while opening.
use_for: opening old CDR files whose text is in a Cyrillic, Greek or Asian code page so it does not turn into garbage
batch-opening client files under one color policy, without per-file profile prompts
avoid: placing a file into an already open document: use Layer.ImportEx with IVGStructImportOptions
current-version files with no color issues: plain Application.OpenDocument is enough
cards.how: Options object of the VGCore model. Application.CreateStructOpenOptions returns a fresh struct; set CodePage and/or the members of ColorConversionOptions, then call Application.OpenDocumentEx(FileName, Options), which returns the opened IVGDocument. Application.OpenDocumentAsCopy(FileName, Options) takes the same struct; for a code page alone, Application.OpenDocument(FileName, CodePage) is enough.

key_members.name: CodePage
key_members.use: Windows code page used to read text from files made by earlier versions

key_members.name: ColorConversionOptions
key_members.use: color-management settings for this open (read-only reference to an IVGStructColorConversionOptions)

gotchas: CodePage only matters for files created in earlier versions (typelib); current files presumably store Unicode text (unverified).
ColorConversionOptions is read-only: change its members, do not assign another struct.
Depending on the color policy, opening may still raise a profile-mismatch or font-substitution dialog, which blocks an automated run (unverified which settings suppress every prompt).
cards.example:
Dim oo As StructOpenOptions, doc As Document
Set oo = Application.CreateStructOpenOptions
oo.CodePage = 1251
Set doc = Application.OpenDocumentEx("C:\old\label_v9.cdr", oo)

review.changes: how: added OpenDocumentAsCopy (takes this struct) and OpenDocument's own CodePage argument; Unicode claim marked unverified

cards.name: IVGStructPaletteOptions
cards.summary: Settings for reducing an image to a palette of a limited number of colors: palette type (uniform, standard VGA, adaptive, optimized, black body, grayscale, system, Internet Explorer, Netscape, custom), number of colors, dither type and intensity, smoothing, a color-sensitive range around a target color (importance, lightness, tolerances) and a custom palette. Passed as PaletteOptions with paletted bitmap exports such as GIF or 8-bit PNG, or to Bitmap.ConvertToPaletted2 to reduce a bitmap in the document.
use_for: small GIF or PNG-8 web icons and banners
limiting a graphic to a fixed number of colors for screen printing or embroidery previews
posterised, limited-palette looks with or without dithering
reducing a placed photo or scan to a limited palette inside the document (Bitmap.ConvertToPaletted2)
avoid: full-color exports: leave PaletteOptions out and use an RGB or CMYK ImageType
reducing vector artwork on the page: the struct only drives bitmap export and bitmap conversion; export or convert to a bitmap first
cards.how: Options object of the VGCore model. Application.CreateStructPaletteOptions returns a fresh struct; set its members and pass it as PaletteOptions to ActiveDocument.ExportEx (with an IVGStructExportOptions whose ImageType is cdrPalettedImage) or to Document.ExportBitmap; Bitmap.ConvertToPaletted2(Options) applies the same struct to a bitmap already in the document.

key_members.name: PaletteType
key_members.use: palette to reduce to (cdrImagePaletteType: adaptive, optimized, uniform, grayscale, custom ...)

key_members.name: NumColors
key_members.use: number of colors in the palette

key_members.name: DitherType
key_members.use: none, ordered, Jarvis, Stucki or Floyd-Steinberg (cdrDitherType)

key_members.name: DitherIntensity
key_members.use: strength of the dither

key_members.name: Smoothing
key_members.use: smoothing applied before reduction

key_members.name: ColorSensitive
key_members.use: favour a range of colors around TargetColor

key_members.name: TargetColor
key_members.use: color the reduction should favour, as a packed number

key_members.name: Importance
key_members.use: weight of the color-sensitive range

key_members.name: Lightness
key_members.use: lightness weight of the color-sensitive range

key_members.name: ToleranceA
key_members.use: first tolerance of the color-sensitive range

key_members.name: ToleranceB
key_members.use: second tolerance of the color-sensitive range

key_members.name: Palette
key_members.use: custom palette (variant) for cdrPaletteCustom

gotchas: None of the members have typelib descriptions; meanings follow the Convert to Paletted / export palette dialog.
Probably ignored unless the export ImageType is cdrPalettedImage (unverified).
A fresh struct may not start with the dialog's defaults: set PaletteType, NumColors and DitherType explicitly (unverified what a fresh struct holds).
TargetColor is a long; its byte order (RGB vs BGR packing) is undocumented (unverified).
The layout of the Palette variant for a custom palette is undocumented (unverified).
cards.example:
Dim eo As StructExportOptions, po As StructPaletteOptions
Set eo = Application.CreateStructExportOptions
Set po = Application.CreateStructPaletteOptions
eo.ImageType = cdrPalettedImage: eo.Overwrite = True
po.PaletteType = cdrPaletteAdaptive: po.NumColors = 64
po.DitherType = cdrDitherNone
ActiveDocument.ExportEx("C:\out\icon.gif", cdrGIF, cdrSelection, eo, po).Finish

review.changes: summary: palette types are cdrPaletteIE / cdrPaletteNetscape, not a generic 'web-safe'; summary/how: added Bitmap.ConvertToPaletted2(Options), which takes this struct; removed the avoid entry that sent in-document bitmap conversion elsewhere (ConvertToPaletted2 takes this struct); added it as a use

cards.name: IVGStructPasteOptions
cards.summary: Settings for Layer.PasteEx. Its only member is the color conversion options applied to clipboard content as it is pasted (color policy, profiles assumed for the incoming colors, profiles to convert the document to).
use_for: pasting RGB artwork from a browser or another app into a CMYK print document under a known color assumption
scripted copy-paste between documents that use different color settings
avoid: choosing the clipboard format or paste position: this struct has no such settings
moving shapes between open documents: Shape.Duplicate / copy to layer avoids the clipboard entirely (unverified for cross-document moves)
cards.how: Options object of the VGCore model. Application.CreateStructPasteOptions returns a fresh struct; adjust the members of its ColorConversionOptions and pass it to ActiveLayer.PasteEx(Options), which returns the pasted shapes as an IVGShapeRange.

key_members.name: ColorConversionOptions
key_members.use: color-management settings for the paste (read-only reference to an IVGStructColorConversionOptions)

gotchas: ColorConversionOptions is read-only: set its members, do not assign another struct.
PasteEx fails or returns nothing when the clipboard is empty or locked by another application (unverified exact behaviour); copy right before pasting.
The clipboard format CorelDRAW picks (native, EMF, bitmap ...) is not controlled by this struct (unverified).
cards.example:
Dim po As StructPasteOptions, sr As ShapeRange
Set po = Application.CreateStructPasteOptions
Debug.Print po.ColorConversionOptions.SourceColorProfileList
Set sr = ActiveLayer.PasteEx(po)
Debug.Print sr.Count

cards.name: IVGStructSaveAsOptions
cards.summary: Settings for Document.SaveAs and SaveAsCopy: file filter, CorelDRAW file version to save as (saving back to older releases), page range, overwrite, ICC profile embedding, VBA project embedding, CMX data, keep-appearance, and the hidden thumbnail size.
use_for: saving a copy for a printer or colleague on an older CorelDRAW version
versioned backups of a job without changing the open document's file path (SaveAsCopy)
files that carry their ICC profile for print hand-off
stripping a macro project out of files sent to clients
avoid: raster or other foreign formats (PNG, PDF, SVG ...): use Document.ExportEx with export options
SaveAs for backups: it re-points the open document to the new file; use SaveAsCopy
cards.how: Options object of the VGCore model. Application.CreateStructSaveAsOptions returns a fresh struct; set members and pass it to ActiveDocument.SaveAs(FileName, Options) or ActiveDocument.SaveAsCopy(FileName, Options).

key_members.name: Filter
key_members.use: file format (cdrFilter), e.g. cdrCDR

key_members.name: Version
key_members.use: CorelDRAW file version (cdrFileVersion): cdrCurrentVersion or an older cdrVersionNN

key_members.name: Range
key_members.use: pages to save (cdrExportRange: all pages, current page, selection)

key_members.name: Overwrite
key_members.use: replace an existing file

key_members.name: EmbedICCProfile
key_members.use: embed the document's color profile

key_members.name: EmbedVBAProject
key_members.use: store the document's VBA project in the file

key_members.name: IncludeCMXData
key_members.use: add CMX presentation data for older readers

key_members.name: KeepAppearance
key_members.use: keep the look of newer features when saving to an older version

key_members.name: ThumbnailSize
key_members.use: preview thumbnail size (hidden member)

gotchas: None of the members have typelib descriptions.
Saving to an older Version converts or drops features that release lacks; KeepAppearance presumably trades editability for looks (unverified exact behaviour).
SaveAs changes the document's file path and name; SaveAsCopy leaves the open document as it was.
ThumbnailSize is a hidden member in 25.1.
With Overwrite = False and an existing file, expect an error or a prompt (unverified which).

Document.SaveAs(path) without this options object fails: create it with Application.CreateStructSaveAsOptions(), set Overwrite = True (EmbedICCProfile = True also ran) and pass it as the second argument (plan runs 2026-10-15 (print_prep.package_for_print)).
cards.example:
Dim so As StructSaveAsOptions
Set so = Application.CreateStructSaveAsOptions
so.Filter = cdrCDR
so.Version = cdrVersion21
so.EmbedICCProfile = True
so.Overwrite = True
ActiveDocument.SaveAsCopy "C:\out\job_for_print.cdr", so

cards.name: IVGStructSpaceProperties
cards.summary: Legacy struct with the spacing of text: character spacing, word spacing, line spacing and how it is measured (percent of character height, points, percent of point size), and space before and after paragraphs. Reached only through hidden IVGText members in 25.1.
use_for: tightening or loosening leading of body copy in old macros
adding paragraph spacing to imported text in one call
reading the spacing of a text object to copy it to another
avoid: new scripts: format spacing through IVGTextRange (Text.Story / Text.Range): CharSpacing, WordSpacing, LineSpacing, and SetLineSpacing(Type, LineSpacing, ParaBefore, ParaAfter) for the spacing type and paragraph spacing (LineSpacingType is read-only on a text range)
kerning between two particular characters: that is a per-character setting, not range spacing
cards.how: Old-style property struct of the VGCore text model. Get it with the hidden IVGText members SpaceProperties(Frames) (default cdrAllFrames) or SpacePropertiesInRange(StartIndex, Count, IndexingType), or an empty one from the hidden Application.CreateStructSpaceProperties; change members and assign it back through the same property.

key_members.name: CharacterSpacing
key_members.use: spacing between characters

key_members.name: WordSpacing
key_members.use: spacing between words

key_members.name: LineSpacing
key_members.use: distance between lines, in the unit set by LineSpacingType

key_members.name: LineSpacingType
key_members.use: cdrLineSpacingType: percent of character height, points, or percent of point size

key_members.name: BeforeParagraphSpacing
key_members.use: space added before each paragraph

key_members.name: AfterParagraphSpacing
key_members.use: space added after each paragraph

gotchas: Every route to this struct is hidden in the 25.1 typelib (IVGText.SpaceProperties, SpacePropertiesInRange, Application.CreateStructSpaceProperties).
None of the members have typelib descriptions.
LineSpacing is read in LineSpacingType, so set the type first; whether the paragraph spacings follow the same type is unverified.
CharacterSpacing and WordSpacing are most likely percent of a space width (unverified).
A range with mixed line spacing reports cdrMixedLineSpacing.
cards.example:
Dim sp As StructSpaceProperties
Set sp = ActiveShape.Text.SpaceProperties(cdrAllFrames)
sp.LineSpacingType = cdrPercentOfCharacterHeightLineSpacing
sp.LineSpacing = 120
sp.AfterParagraphSpacing = 50
ActiveShape.Text.SpaceProperties(cdrAllFrames) = sp

review.changes: avoid: named the IVGTextRange spacing members and SetLineSpacing (LineSpacingType is read-only there)

cards.name: IVGStyle
cards.summary: One object style or style set from CorelDRAW's Object Styles system: a named, reusable bundle of outline, fill, transparency, character, paragraph or frame properties that shapes and text link to, with inheritance (BasedOn / DerivedStyles) and local overrides. It is also what Shape.Style returns (typelib: the style set applied to the shape) and what TextRange.ObjectStyle returns (the style applied to the text). Changing a style restyles every linked object.
use_for: brand style sets (fill + outline + type) applied to many objects so one edit restyles the whole layout
reading or copying a shape's look property by property
serialising a style to a string and restoring it elsewhere (ToString / StringAssign)
renaming, re-parenting or deleting styles in a template
avoid: one-off formatting of a single object: set the shape's Fill / Outline directly
styles that must survive in Photoshop or Illustrator: object styles do not export as styles
cards.how: Style object of the VGCore model. A script gets one from ActiveDocument.StyleSheet (FindStyle, Styles, StyleSets, AllStyles, CreateStyle, CreateStyleSet), from a shape's Style or a text range's ObjectStyle, or by walking BasedOn / DerivedStyles. Properties are read and written by name (GetProperty, SetProperty, GetPropertyAsString) or through the typed views Fill, Outline and Transparency; objects are linked with Shape.ApplyStyle(Name).

key_members.name: Name
key_members.use: name of the style (typelib); presumably the one FindStyle and ApplyStyle take (unverified)

key_members.name: DisplayName
key_members.use: name as shown in the Object Styles docker

key_members.name: CategoryName
key_members.use: category of the style (fill, outline, character ...; exact strings unverified)

key_members.name: IsStyleSet
key_members.use: True for a style set (several categories) rather than a single style

key_members.name: IsObjectDefaults
key_members.use: True for the style sets that hold default properties of an object type

key_members.name: BasedOn
key_members.use: parent style it inherits from

key_members.name: DerivedStyles
key_members.use: child styles that inherit from it

key_members.name: GetAllPropertyNames
key_members.use: names of every property in the category: discover what GetProperty accepts

key_members.name: GetOverridePropertyNames
key_members.use: properties set locally rather than inherited

key_members.name: IsPropertyInherited
key_members.use: whether one property comes from the parent

key_members.name: GetProperty
key_members.use: read a property by name

key_members.name: SetProperty
key_members.use: write a property by name

key_members.name: ClearProperty
key_members.use: remove a local override so the parent value applies again

key_members.name: Fill
key_members.use: typed fill view (IVGStyleFill)

key_members.name: Outline
key_members.use: typed outline view (IVGStyleOutline)

key_members.name: Transparency
key_members.use: typed transparency view (IVGStyleTransparency)

key_members.name: ToString
key_members.use: all properties as one string

key_members.name: StringAssign
key_members.use: restore properties from such a string

key_members.name: SetBasedOn
key_members.use: re-parent the style

key_members.name: Rename
key_members.use: rename the style

gotchas: Property names for GetProperty / SetProperty are internal strings the typelib does not list; call GetAllPropertyNames on a style of the right category first (unverified exact names).
Editing a style restyles every linked object and every derived style that inherits the property.
Character, Paragraph and Frame views only expose Style again; their properties are reached by name, unlike Fill / Outline / Transparency which are typed.
Object-default style sets (IsObjectDefaults) set what new objects get; editing them does not restyle existing shapes (unverified).
Delete on a style still in use: what happens to linked objects is unverified (they likely keep the look as local properties).
Shape.Style returns the style set applied to the shape (typelib); editing it may restyle every object that uses that style set, not only this shape (unverified); test on a copy.
cards.example:
Dim st As Style, n
Set st = ActiveDocument.StyleSheet.FindStyle("Headline")
Debug.Print st.CategoryName, st.IsStyleSet
For Each n In st.GetAllPropertyNames
  Debug.Print n, st.GetPropertyAsString(n)
Next
ActiveShape.ApplyStyle st.Name

review.changes: summary: the typelib describes Shape.Style as 'a styleset applied to the shape', not the shape's own local properties; gotcha on Shape.Style rewritten to match the typelib; CategoryName strings marked unverified; Name: 'the one ApplyStyle and FindStyle use' marked unverified

cards.name: IVGStyleCharacter
cards.summary: The character-formatting part of an object style or style set (font, size, weight, character color and similar text properties; the typelib does not list them). This interface only hands back the generic IVGStyle that holds those properties; there are no typed font members here, so character properties are read and written by name.
use_for: brand typography: a character style for headlines or captions applied to many text objects
listing or changing the font properties stored in a style through GetAllPropertyNames / SetProperty
avoid: formatting one text object directly: use IVGTextRange (Font, Size, Bold ...)
typed fill / outline edits: those have their own views (IVGStyleFill, IVGStyleOutline)
cards.how: Category view of the VGCore Object Styles model. Reached from IVGStyle.Character on a character style or a style set (from ActiveDocument.StyleSheet or a shape / text range's style). Its only member, Style, returns the IVGStyle whose GetProperty / SetProperty / GetAllPropertyNames work on the character properties.

key_members.name: Style
key_members.use: generic IVGStyle object carrying the character properties

gotchas: No typed members: discover property names with Style.GetAllPropertyNames (unverified exact names such as font or size keys).
On a style of another category Character may return Nothing or an empty view (unverified).
Edits restyle every text object linked to the style.
cards.example:
Dim cs As StyleCharacter
Set cs = ActiveDocument.StyleSheet.FindStyle("Body text").Character
Debug.Print Join(cs.Style.GetAllPropertyNames, ", ")

review.changes: summary: property set flagged as not listed in the typelib

cards.name: IVGStyleFill
cards.summary: Typed view of the fill part of an object style: fill type (none, uniform, fountain, PostScript, two-color / bitmap / full-color pattern, texture, hatch), fountain settings (linear / radial / conical / square, steps, blend, midpoint, center offset, scale, spread, acceleration, first and last stop color and opacity), pattern tile size, origin, offset and mirroring, rotation and skew, overprint, winding rule, and saving or loading fills to files. Editing it refills every linked object.
use_for: a brand gradient defined once as a style and reused on buttons, badges and backgrounds
switching a whole template from flat to gradient fills in one edit
pattern or texture fills with set tile size and mirroring for packaging
saving a fill to a file and loading it into styles in other documents (SaveFill / LoadFill)
avoid: one object's fill: set Shape.Fill directly
fountain fills with more than two stops: this view only exposes the first and last stop colors
cards.how: Category view of the VGCore Object Styles model. Reached from IVGStyle.Fill on a fill style or style set (ActiveDocument.StyleSheet.FindStyle(...).Fill, Shape.Style.Fill) and from IVGStyleTransparency.Fill for a transparency's fill. Set members directly; Style returns the generic IVGStyle.

key_members.name: Type
key_members.use: fill type (cdrFillStyleType)

key_members.name: PrimaryColor
key_members.use: color of the first fountain color stop (IVGColor, read-only reference); presumably also the color of a uniform fill (unverified)

key_members.name: SecondaryColor
key_members.use: color of the last fountain stop (IVGColor, read-only reference)

key_members.name: FountainFillType
key_members.use: linear, radial, conical or square fountain

key_members.name: FountainSteps
key_members.use: number of steps, 0 = unlimited / smooth

key_members.name: FountainBlendType
key_members.use: blend type between the first pair of colors

key_members.name: MidPoint
key_members.use: midpoint between the first pair of colors

key_members.name: FlipColors
key_members.use: reverse the fountain colors

key_members.name: FountainCenterXOffset
key_members.use: horizontal offset of the fountain center

key_members.name: FountainCenterYOffset
key_members.use: vertical offset of the fountain center

key_members.name: FountainSpreadMethod
key_members.use: how the fountain continues past its ends

key_members.name: PrimaryOpacity
key_members.use: opacity of the first stop

key_members.name: SecondaryOpacity
key_members.use: opacity of the last stop

key_members.name: RotationAngle
key_members.use: fill rotation angle

key_members.name: TileWidth
key_members.use: pattern / texture tile width

key_members.name: TileHeight
key_members.use: pattern / texture tile height

key_members.name: MirrorFillX
key_members.use: mirror tiles horizontally

key_members.name: TransformWithShape
key_members.use: fill scales / rotates with the object

key_members.name: Overprint
key_members.use: overprint the fill in separations

key_members.name: LoadFill
key_members.use: load a fill from a file into the style

gotchas: EdgePad, FountainCenterOffsetX, FountainCenterOffsetY and MirrorFill are marked obsolete in the typelib (the first three are also hidden); use FountainCenterXOffset / FountainCenterYOffset and MirrorFillX / MirrorFillY.
MergeMode is a hidden member in 25.1.
PrimaryColor and SecondaryColor are read-only references: change the color through the IVGColor object (e.g. RGBAssign); whether the style updates at once is unverified.
Only the first and last fountain stops are exposed; intermediate stops are out of reach here.
PrimaryOpacity / SecondaryOpacity are bytes; whether 255 means opaque is unverified.
The file format SaveFill / LoadFill expect is not stated in the typelib (unverified extension).
cards.example:
Dim f As StyleFill
Set f = ActiveDocument.StyleSheet.FindStyle("Brand gradient").Fill
f.Type = cdrFountainFillStyle
f.FountainFillType = cdrLinearFountainFill
f.RotationAngle = 45
f.FountainSteps = 0
f.PrimaryColor.RGBAssign 255, 80, 0
f.SecondaryColor.RGBAssign 120, 0, 160

review.changes: PrimaryColor: 'uniform color' marked unverified (typelib only says fountain color stop)

cards.name: IVGStyleFrame
cards.summary: The frame part of an object style or style set, for paragraph-text frame properties (likely columns, gutters, vertical alignment and similar frame settings; the exact set is not listed in the typelib). The interface only hands back the generic IVGStyle; frame properties are read and written by name.
use_for: a consistent column and alignment setup for paragraph-text frames across a brochure or catalogue template
listing which frame properties a style carries via GetAllPropertyNames
avoid: text formatting (font, size): that is the character / paragraph part of the style
artistic text, which has no frame (unverified that a frame style has any effect on it)
cards.how: Category view of the VGCore Object Styles model. Reached from IVGStyle.Frame on a frame style or a style set from ActiveDocument.StyleSheet. Its only member, Style, returns the IVGStyle whose GetProperty / SetProperty / GetAllPropertyNames work on the frame properties.

key_members.name: Style
key_members.use: generic IVGStyle object carrying the frame properties

gotchas: No typed members and no description of which properties exist: call Style.GetAllPropertyNames before relying on any name (unverified property set).
On a style of another category Frame may return Nothing or an empty view (unverified).
Edits reach every frame linked to the style.
cards.example:
Dim fr As StyleFrame
Set fr = ActiveDocument.StyleSheet.FindStyle("Two columns").Frame
Debug.Print Join(fr.Style.GetAllPropertyNames, ", ")

cards.name: IVGStyleOutline
cards.summary: Typed view of the outline part of an object style: outline type, width, color, line caps, corner joins, miter limit, position (centered, inside or outside the path), behind fill, scale with object, overprint, calligraphic nib stretch and angle, arrowhead overlap and sharing, dash adjustment and wide-line width. Editing it changes the stroke of every linked object.
use_for: one hairline or cut-line style (e.g. 0.25 pt, no scaling) shared by every die line in a packaging file
brand icon strokes with fixed caps, joins and inside alignment
turning Scale With Object off across a whole logo set so strokes stay constant at any size
avoid: a single object's outline: set Shape.Outline directly
dash patterns and arrowhead shapes themselves: not typed here, reach them by name through Style (unverified names)
cards.how: Category view of the VGCore Object Styles model. Reached from IVGStyle.Outline on an outline style or style set (ActiveDocument.StyleSheet.FindStyle(...).Outline, Shape.Style.Outline). Set members directly; Style returns the generic IVGStyle for name-based access.

key_members.name: Type
key_members.use: outline type (cdrOutlineType)

key_members.name: Width
key_members.use: outline width

key_members.name: Color
key_members.use: outline color (IVGColor)

key_members.name: LineCaps
key_members.use: end caps (cdrOutlineLineCaps)

key_members.name: LineJoin
key_members.use: corner joins: miter, round or bevel

key_members.name: MiterLimit
key_members.use: angle limit before a miter join is beveled

key_members.name: Justification
key_members.use: outline centered on, inside or outside the path

key_members.name: BehindFill
key_members.use: draw the outline behind the fill

key_members.name: ScaleWithShape
key_members.use: scale the outline when the object is resized

key_members.name: Overprint
key_members.use: overprint the outline in separations

key_members.name: NibStretch
key_members.use: calligraphic nib stretch ratio

key_members.name: NibAngle
key_members.use: calligraphic nib angle

key_members.name: AdjustDashes
key_members.use: how dashes adjust to corners and ends

key_members.name: OverlapArrow
key_members.use: arrowhead overlaps the segment end

key_members.name: ShareArrow
key_members.use: both arrowheads share their properties

key_members.name: WidelineWidth
key_members.use: width of the wide-line outline

key_members.name: Style
key_members.use: generic IVGStyle for name-based property access

gotchas: The unit of Width is not stated in the typelib; read an existing value before writing (unverified whether it follows the document unit).
Color is an IVGColor object: change it with its own methods (RGBAssign, CMYKAssign).
WidelineWidth is only described as 'width of the wide line outline'; what wide line means here is unverified.
Changing the style restyles every linked object at once; derived styles that inherit the property change too.
cards.example:
Dim o As StyleOutline
Set o = ActiveDocument.StyleSheet.FindStyle("Die line").Outline
o.Width = 0.25
o.LineJoin = cdrOutlineRoundLineJoin
o.Justification = cdrOutlineJustificationInside
o.ScaleWithShape = False
o.Color.CMYKAssign 0, 100, 0, 0

cards.name: IVGStyleParagraph
cards.summary: The paragraph-formatting part of an object style or style set (alignment, indents, paragraph spacing and similar paragraph settings; the typelib does not list them). This interface only hands back the generic IVGStyle; paragraph properties are read and written by name.
use_for: body-copy and caption paragraph styles applied across a brochure or catalogue template
listing or changing paragraph settings stored in a style via GetAllPropertyNames / SetProperty
avoid: formatting one paragraph directly: use IVGTextRange
character formatting (font, size): that lives in the character part (IVGStyleCharacter)
cards.how: Category view of the VGCore Object Styles model. Reached from IVGStyle.Paragraph on a paragraph style or a style set from ActiveDocument.StyleSheet or a text range's ObjectStyle. Its only member, Style, returns the IVGStyle whose GetProperty / SetProperty / GetAllPropertyNames work on the paragraph properties.

key_members.name: Style
key_members.use: generic IVGStyle object carrying the paragraph properties

gotchas: No typed members: discover property names with Style.GetAllPropertyNames (unverified exact names).
On a style of another category Paragraph may return Nothing or an empty view (unverified).
Edits reach every paragraph linked to the style.
cards.example:
Dim ps As StyleParagraph
Set ps = ActiveDocument.StyleSheet.FindStyle("Body text").Paragraph
Debug.Print Join(ps.Style.GetAllPropertyNames, ", ")

review.changes: summary: property set flagged as not listed in the typelib

cards.name: IVGStyles
cards.summary: A list of object styles or style sets: the top-level styles, style sets or object defaults of a style sheet, every style in it, the children of one style, or the styles just made by a CreateStyleFrom... call. Gives the count, items by index, lookup by name, first / last and For Each.
use_for: listing every style in a template to audit or document a brand system
finding a style by name before applying or editing it
walking a style's children to see what an edit will affect
avoid: creating or deleting styles: use IVGStyleSheet (CreateStyle ...) and IVGStyle.Delete
cards.how: Collection of the VGCore Object Styles model. Returned by ActiveDocument.StyleSheet.Styles / StyleSets / ObjectDefaults / AllStyles / AllStyleSets, by IVGStyle.DerivedStyles and by the StyleSheet.CreateStyleFrom... / CreateStyleSetFrom... methods. Item(Index) is the default member and For Each works through _NewEnum.

key_members.name: Count
key_members.use: number of styles in the list

key_members.name: Item
key_members.use: style at a numeric index

key_members.name: Find
key_members.use: style by name

key_members.name: First
key_members.use: first style in the list

key_members.name: Last
key_members.use: last style in the list

key_members.name: _NewEnum
key_members.use: enumerator behind For Each

gotchas: Item takes a long index only; use Find for names.
StyleSheet.Styles and StyleSets list top-level entries only; use AllStyles / AllStyleSets or DerivedStyles to see children.
Indexing is probably base 1 like other VGCore collections (unverified).
Find returns Nothing rather than raising when the name is missing (unverified); test the result.
cards.example:
Dim st As Style
For Each st In ActiveDocument.StyleSheet.AllStyles
  Debug.Print st.DisplayName, st.CategoryName
Next
Debug.Print ActiveDocument.StyleSheet.AllStyleSets.Count

cards.name: IVGStyleSheet
cards.summary: A document's Object Styles store: its styles, style sets, object defaults and color styles. Through it a script creates styles from existing shapes or text or from scratch, finds them by name, exports and imports style sheets to and from files, and creates, renames and deletes color styles.
use_for: building a brand style sheet from a designed sample object (CreateStyleSetFromShape) and applying it across a layout
moving a style system between templates with Export / Import
defining brand color styles that recolor every linked object when changed
auditing which styles and color styles a client file contains
avoid: formatting a few objects once: set their properties directly
editing a single style's properties: get it (FindStyle) and use IVGStyle and its typed views
cards.how: Style-sheet object of the VGCore Object Styles model, one per document: ActiveDocument.StyleSheet. Create with CreateStyle / CreateStyleSet or from a shape, shape range or text range; look up with FindStyle or the Styles / StyleSets / AllStyles lists; link objects with Shape.ApplyStyle(Name).

key_members.name: Styles
key_members.use: top-level styles

key_members.name: StyleSets
key_members.use: top-level style sets

key_members.name: ObjectDefaults
key_members.use: style sets that hold default properties for new objects

key_members.name: AllStyles
key_members.use: every style, nested ones included

key_members.name: AllStyleSets
key_members.use: every style set, nested ones included

key_members.name: FindStyle
key_members.use: a style or style set by name

key_members.name: CreateStyle
key_members.use: new style of a category, optionally based on another

key_members.name: CreateStyleSet
key_members.use: new style set, optionally based on another (BasedOn)

key_members.name: CreateStyleFromShape
key_members.use: style of one category taken from a shape's look

key_members.name: CreateStyleSetFromShape
key_members.use: style set taken from a shape's look

key_members.name: CreateStyleFromTextRange
key_members.use: style taken from a piece of text

key_members.name: CreateStyleSetFromTextRange
key_members.use: style set taken from a piece of text

key_members.name: Export
key_members.use: write styles, style sets, object defaults and / or color styles to a file

key_members.name: Import
key_members.use: read them from a file, optionally merging

key_members.name: AllColorStyles
key_members.use: all color styles of the document

key_members.name: CreateColorStyle
key_members.use: new color style from an IVGColor

key_members.name: RenameColorStyle
key_members.use: rename a color style

key_members.name: DeleteColorStyle
key_members.use: delete one color style

key_members.name: DeleteAllColorStyles

gotchas: Category names for CreateStyle / CreateStyleFrom... are strings the typelib does not list (fill, outline, character, paragraph, frame, transparency are likely; unverified exact spelling). Read CategoryName from an existing style to be sure.
ReplaceExisting defaults to False: re-running a script that creates a style with the same name may fail or produce a renamed copy (unverified which); pass True for repeatable builds.
The CreateStyleFrom... and CreateStyleSetFrom... methods return IVGStyles (a list), not one IVGStyle.
Export and Import flags all default to False: pass True for each part you want, or possibly nothing is written or read (unverified).
DeleteAllColorStyles removes every color style; whether objects keep their colors unlinked is unverified, so try it on a copy.
cards.example:
Dim ss As StyleSheet, made As Styles
Set ss = ActiveDocument.StyleSheet
Set made = ss.CreateStyleSetFromShape(ActiveShape, "Card title", True)
Debug.Print made.Count, ss.AllStyleSets.Count
ss.CreateColorStyle "Brand Orange", ActiveShape.Fill.UniformColor, , , True
ss.Export "C:\styles\brand.cdss", True, True, False, True

review.changes: CreateStyleSet: not necessarily empty, it takes BasedOn

cards.name: IVGStyleTransparency
cards.summary: Typed view of the transparency part of an object style: the transparency's own fill (uniform, fountain, pattern, texture ...), its merge mode (normal, multiply, screen, overlay ...), the uniform transparency amount, the levels used for white and black areas of pattern / bitmap transparencies, and whether it applies to fill, outline or both.
use_for: a shared 'overlay' style (e.g. 50% multiply) for image tints and shadows across a layout
gradient fade-outs defined once and reused on many objects
transparency that affects only fills, leaving outlines solid
avoid: a single object's transparency: set it on the shape directly
print jobs bound for old RIPs that flatten transparency badly: test the output first
cards.how: Category view of the VGCore Object Styles model. Reached from IVGStyle.Transparency on a transparency style or style set from ActiveDocument.StyleSheet or Shape.Style. Fill returns an IVGStyleFill whose Type picks uniform, fountain or pattern transparency; Style returns the generic IVGStyle.

key_members.name: Fill
key_members.use: fill that drives the transparency (IVGStyleFill: uniform, fountain, pattern ...)

key_members.name: Mode
key_members.use: merge mode (cdrMergeMode: normal, multiply, screen, overlay ...)

key_members.name: UniformTransparency
key_members.use: transparency amount of a uniform transparency

key_members.name: WhiteTransparency
key_members.use: transparency level for white areas of the transparency fill

key_members.name: BlackTransparency
key_members.use: transparency level for black areas of the transparency fill

key_members.name: AppliesTo
key_members.use: fill, outline or both (cdrTransparencyAppliedTo)

key_members.name: Style
key_members.use: generic IVGStyle for name-based access

gotchas: The typelib description of UniformTransparency is copy-pasted ('winding rule'); it is the uniform transparency amount, and its scale (0-100 is likely) is unverified.
The interface description also says 'StyleFill class': another copy-paste; the members are transparency settings.
Fill is read-only as a reference: set Fill.Type and its members, do not assign another object.
WhiteTransparency / BlackTransparency only matter for two-color, bitmap or texture transparency fills (unverified).
cards.example:
Dim t As StyleTransparency
Set t = ActiveDocument.StyleSheet.FindStyle("Overlay 50").Transparency
t.Fill.Type = cdrUniformFillStyle
t.UniformTransparency = 50
t.Mode = cdrMergeMultiply
t.AppliesTo = cdrApplyToFill

cards.name: IVGSubPath
cards.summary: One continuous piece of a curve object; a compound curve such as the letter O or a combined logo has several. Through it a script measures the piece (length, area, size, direction, bounding box, points, tangents, curvature), tests points against it, edits it (close / open, reverse, move, append line or curve segments, add nodes, break apart, divide equally, delete) and pulls it out as its own curve.
use_for: separating the pieces of a combined logo or traced artwork (Extract)
fixing winding: reversing subpaths so holes cut correctly, or checking IsClockwise
measuring outline lengths and areas for cutting, engraving or material estimates
placing evenly spaced dots or stitches along a path (GetEvenlySpacedPoints)
building a path node by node from data (AppendLineSegment / AppendCurveSegment2)
avoid: rectangles, ellipses and text that are not curves yet: ConvertToCurves first
node-level edits of one segment (handle angles and lengths): use IVGSegment
whole-object transforms: use the shape's own move / scale / rotate
cards.how: Subpath object of the VGCore curve model. A script reaches it from a curve shape: ActiveShape.Curve.SubPaths(i) or SubPaths.First / Last, from a node or segment (IVGNode.SubPath, IVGSegment.SubPath), by walking Next / Previous, or as the result of Curve.CreateSubPath(x, y). Its Nodes and Segments give node / segment collections of this piece only. Numbers are in the document's unit.

key_members.name: Index
key_members.use: position within its curve (base 1)

key_members.name: Closed
key_members.use: read or set whether the piece is closed

key_members.name: Length
key_members.use: length in document units

key_members.name: Area
key_members.use: area of a closed piece

key_members.name: IsClockwise
key_members.use: overall direction of the path

key_members.name: Nodes

gotchas: The *At methods here default to OffsetType 1 = cdrRelativeSegmentOffset (a fraction of this subpath's length), unlike IVGSegment whose default is 2 = cdrParamSegmentOffset; pass the OffsetType explicitly when porting code between the two.
Lengths, positions and areas are in ActiveDocument.Unit; set it (e.g. cdrMillimeter) before reading or writing numbers.
Area and IsPointInside only make sense on a Closed piece (typelib: 'area of a closed path').
Extract, Delete, AddNodeAt, BreakApartAt and EqualDivide change the curve, so SubPaths indexes and counts shift; loop from the last subpath backwards or re-read Curve.SubPaths.
GetPosition, GetPointPositionAt and GetBoundingBox return through ByRef arguments; from Python / pywin32 BoundingBox and GetPointAt are simpler (unverified how pywin32 surfaces the ByRef values).
What Gap = -1 (default) does in EqualDivide and how ScaleDistanceToFit adjusts spacing in GetEvenlySpacedPoints is unverified; test on a copy.
cards.example:
Dim sp As SubPath
ActiveDocument.Unit = cdrMillimeter
For Each sp In ActiveShape.Curve.SubPaths
  Debug.Print sp.Index, sp.Closed, sp.Length, sp.IsClockwise
Next
Set sp = ActiveShape.Curve.SubPaths(1)
If Not sp.IsClockwise Then sp.ReverseDirection
sp.AddNodeAt 0.5, cdrRelativeSegmentOffset

cards.name: IVGSubPaths
cards.summary: The list of subpaths (separate continuous pieces) of one curve object: count, items by index, first, last and For Each. A single open or closed path has one; combined shapes, letters with counters and traced artwork have several.
use_for: counting the pieces of a combined or traced object before cleaning it up
looping over every piece to measure, reverse or extract it
finding the outer contour among holes (e.g. the largest Area)
avoid: adding a new piece: use Curve.CreateSubPath / CreateSubPathFromArray, the collection has no Add
objects that are not curves: ConvertToCurves first
cards.how: Collection of the VGCore curve model. A script reaches it as ActiveShape.Curve.SubPaths (any IVGCurve). Item(Index) is base 1 and the default member; For Each works through _NewEnum; Parent is the curve.

key_members.name: Count
key_members.use: number of subpaths in the curve

key_members.name: Item
key_members.use: subpath at an index (base 1)

key_members.name: First
key_members.use: first subpath

key_members.name: Last
key_members.use: last subpath

key_members.name: _NewEnum
key_members.use: enumerator behind For Each

key_members.name: Parent
key_members.use: the curve that owns the subpaths

gotchas: The typelib description of Item says 'node' (copy-paste); it returns an IVGSubPath.
Count and indexes change when a subpath is extracted, deleted, combined or broken apart; loop backwards when editing.
Only curve shapes have a Curve; rectangles, ellipses and text need ConvertToCurves first (unverified whether Curve is Nothing or raises on them).
cards.example:
Dim sps As SubPaths, i As Long
Set sps = ActiveShape.Curve.SubPaths
Debug.Print sps.Count
For i = sps.Count To 1 Step -1
  If sps(i).Length < 1 Then sps(i).Delete
Next

cards.name: IVGSymbol
cards.summary: The symbol side of a symbol instance shape: gives the definition it is an instance of and can turn the instance back into ordinary editable shapes. Placement, scale and rotation of the instance live on the shape, not here.
use_for: finding which symbol each placed instance uses, e.g. to count logo or icon placements
breaking selected instances into plain shapes for one-off edits (RevertToShapes)
avoid: editing the artwork of every instance: edit the definition (IVGSymbolDefinition.EnterEditMode) instead of reverting
shapes that are not symbol instances: Shape.Symbol is only meaningful when Shape.Type is cdrSymbolShape
cards.how: Symbol-instance object of the VGCore model. A script reaches it as Shape.Symbol on a shape whose Type is cdrSymbolShape (instances are placed with Layer.CreateSymbol or made by Shape.ConvertToSymbol).

key_members.name: Definition
key_members.use: the IVGSymbolDefinition this instance shows

key_members.name: RevertToShapes
key_members.use: convert the instance into normal shapes and return them as a shape range

gotchas: RevertToShapes cuts the link: later edits to the definition no longer reach those shapes.
Check Shape.Type = cdrSymbolShape first; Shape.Symbol on other shapes returns Nothing or raises (unverified which).
The instance's position, size and rotation are properties of the Shape, not of this object.
cards.example:
Dim s As Shape
For Each s In ActivePage.Shapes
  If s.Type = cdrSymbolShape Then
    Debug.Print s.Symbol.Definition.Name
  End If
Next

cards.name: IVGSymbolDefinition
cards.summary: The master artwork of a symbol: name, description, type, link state to an external library, nested symbols, how many instances use it and which ones, plus editing (enter / leave edit mode), duplicate, copy, delete, and link maintenance (break, update, fix). Editing a definition updates every instance at once.
use_for: repeated logos, icons and seating or map markers kept as one master, so one edit updates every copy
auditing a file for broken or outdated links to external symbol libraries before sending it out
counting how many times an icon or part is placed (InstanceCount) for a parts list
localising a linked symbol (BreakLink) before handing a file to someone without the library
avoid: changing a single instance: revert that instance (IVGSymbol.RevertToShapes) or use a different definition
linked definitions you need to edit: check Editable; they are probably not editable until BreakLink makes them local (unverified)
cards.how: Symbol-definition object of the VGCore model. A script reaches it from ActiveDocument.SymbolLibrary.Symbols(IndexOrName) (local library), from an external library in Application.SymbolLibraries, from an instance (Shape.Symbol.Definition), or from NestedSymbols. New definitions come from Shape / ShapeRange.ConvertToSymbol(Name); instances are placed with Layer.CreateSymbol(x, y, Name, Library).

The sprite and button values of Type are legacy web-graphics types (unverified that 25.1 still creates them).
cards.example:
Dim def As SymbolDefinition
For Each def In ActiveDocument.SymbolLibrary.Symbols
  Debug.Print def.Name, def.InstanceCount, def.Linked, def.IsLinkBroken
  If def.Linked And def.IsLinkUpdated Then def.UpdateLinks
Next

cards.name: IVGSymbolDefinitions
cards.summary: A list of symbol definitions: all symbols of one library (local or external) or the sub-symbols nested inside a symbol. Gives the count, items by index or by name, and For Each.
use_for: listing every symbol in a document or library to audit or document an icon set
fetching a symbol by name before placing it with Layer.CreateSymbol
avoid: creating symbols: use Shape / ShapeRange.ConvertToSymbol, the collection has no Add
deleting symbols: call IVGSymbolDefinition.Delete on the item
cards.how: Collection of the VGCore symbol model. A script reaches it as IVGSymbolLibrary.Symbols (ActiveDocument.SymbolLibrary.Symbols for the local library, Application.SymbolLibraries(i).Symbols for an external one) or IVGSymbolDefinition.NestedSymbols. Item(IndexOrName) accepts a number or a name; For Each works through _NewEnum.

key_members.name: Item
key_members.use: definition by index or by name

key_members.name: Count
key_members.use: number of definitions

key_members.name: _NewEnum
key_members.use: enumerator behind For Each

gotchas: Item with a name that does not exist most likely raises an error rather than returning Nothing (unverified); loop or trap the error.
Index is probably base 1 like other VGCore collections (unverified).
Deleting definitions while iterating with For Each can skip items; collect names first, then delete.

Dim syms As SymbolDefinitions
Set syms = ActiveDocument.SymbolLibrary.Symbols
Debug.Print syms.Count
If syms.Count > 0 Then Debug.Print syms(1).Name, syms(1).InstanceCount

cards.name: IVGSymbolLibraries
cards.summary: The symbol libraries visible in the Symbols docker (typelib wording; whether a document's local library is among them is unverified): count, items by index or name, adding one library file, or adding every library in a folder (optionally recursive, optionally copied locally). Symbols from these libraries can be placed as linked instances in any document.
use_for: registering a shared brand icon or signage-symbol library on a workstation by script
loading a folder of client symbol libraries before a batch build
listing which external libraries are available before placing symbols
avoid: a document's own symbols: they are in ActiveDocument.SymbolLibrary (the local library)
cards.how: Application-level collection of the VGCore symbol model: Application.SymbolLibraries. Add(FileName, CopyLocally) and AddFromFolder(Folder, Recursive, CopyLocally) register library files; Item(IndexOrName) returns an IVGSymbolLibrary; For Each works through _NewEnum.

key_members.name: Count
key_members.use: number of registered libraries

key_members.name: Item
key_members.use: library by index or name

key_members.name: Add
key_members.use: register one library file; returns the IVGSymbolLibrary

key_members.name: AddFromFolder
key_members.use: register every library in a folder; returns how many were added

key_members.name: _NewEnum
key_members.use: enumerator behind For Each

gotchas: CopyLocally (default False) presumably copies the library file into the user's own library folder instead of linking it in place (unverified).
Whether added libraries stay registered in the next CorelDRAW session is unverified.
The library file format is CorelDRAW's symbol library (.csl) (unverified that Add accepts other files).
Instances placed from an external library are linked: moving or renaming the library file later breaks those links (see IVGSymbolDefinition.IsLinkBroken / FixLink).
cards.example:
Dim lib As SymbolLibrary
Set lib = Application.SymbolLibraries.Add("C:\assets\icons.csl")
Debug.Print lib.Name, lib.Symbols.Count
ActiveLayer.CreateSymbol 50, 50, lib.Symbols(1).Name, lib

review.changes: summary follows the typelib ('all symbol libraries visible in the Symbols docker') instead of claiming external libraries only

cards.name: IVGSymbolLibrary

Gives its symbols, name, file path and read-only state; a local library can purge unused symbols and paste a copied symbol in, an external one can be removed.
use_for: cleaning a file before hand-off by purging symbol definitions nobody uses
listing the symbols a document defines
copying a symbol from one document's library into another's (SymbolDefinition.Copy then Paste)
avoid: registering new external libraries: use Application.SymbolLibraries.Add
PurgeUnusedSymbols on a template whose spare symbols are meant to stay
cards.how: Library object of the VGCore symbol model. The local one is ActiveDocument.SymbolLibrary; external ones come from Application.SymbolLibraries(IndexOrName) or SymbolLibraries.Add. Symbols lists its definitions; pass the library as the Library argument of Layer.CreateSymbol to place one of its symbols.

Dim lib As SymbolLibrary
Set lib = ActiveDocument.SymbolLibrary
Debug.Print lib.Name, lib.Symbols.Count, lib.ReadOnly
lib.PurgeUnusedSymbols
Debug.Print lib.Symbols.Count

cards.name: IVGText
cards.summary: The text side of a text shape (artistic or paragraph text): its type, the whole story and ranges of it, the frames of linked paragraph text and whether text overflows them, find and replace, converting between artistic and paragraph text, fitting text to a path or the text to its frame, and importing or exporting text files.
use_for: template fills and data merges: replacing placeholders such as {NAME} in a layout
checking every paragraph frame for overflow before sending a brochure to print
fitting headlines or captions to their frame (FitTextToFrame)
setting text along a curve for badges and seals (FitToPath)
importing body copy from a text file into a frame
avoid: character formatting: work on the IVGTextRange from Story or Range (Font, Size, Bold, Fill)
turning text into outlines: that is Shape.ConvertToCurves, not a text call

gotchas: Contents, FontProperties, AlignProperties, SpaceProperties, HyphenationSettings and their ...InRange variants are hidden in the 25.1 typelib (old text model); use Story.Text and IVGTextRange formatting instead.

Overflow only means something for paragraph text in frames; artistic text grows instead.
FitTextToFrame changes the font size of the text to fill the frame (unverified whether it also enlarges short text).
BeginEdit puts the object into an editing state like the Text tool does; avoid it in unattended batch runs (unverified side effects).

Dim t As Text
Set t = ActiveShape.Text
Debug.Print t.Type, t.Story.Text
t.Replace "{NAME}", "Client Name", False, , True
If t.Overflow Then t.FitTextToFrame

cards.name: IVGTextCharacters
cards.summary: The characters of a text range as a collection: count (paragraph breaks included), a run of characters from an index, all, first, last and For Each. Every item comes back as an IVGTextRange, so it can be formatted like any text range.
use_for: per-letter effects: alternating colors or sizes on a headline
styling the first character of a paragraph (drop-cap look) or the last one
counting characters to check copy length against a layout limit
avoid: formatting whole words or paragraphs: use the Words / Paragraphs collections or IVGTextRange directly
long stories letter by letter: one call on a TextRange is far faster than thousands of single-character edits
cards.how: Collection of the VGCore text model. A script reaches it as IVGTextRange.Characters, e.g. ActiveShape.Text.Story.Characters. Item(Index, Count) returns a TextRange of Count characters starting at Index; All / First / Last return TextRanges; For Each works through _NewEnum.

key_members.name: Count
key_members.use: number of characters, paragraph breaks included

key_members.name: Item
key_members.use: TextRange of Count characters starting at Index

key_members.name: All
key_members.use: TextRange of every character

key_members.name: First
key_members.use: TextRange of the first character

key_members.name: Last
key_members.use: TextRange of the last character

key_members.name: _NewEnum
key_members.use: enumerator behind For Each

gotchas: Count includes paragraph breaks (typelib), so it is larger than the visible letter count in multi-paragraph text.
Indexing is probably base 1 like other VGCore collections (unverified).
Inserting or deleting text while looping shifts indexes; read Count again or loop from the end.
Per-character loops over long stories are slow, especially across COM from Python.
cards.example:
Dim chars As TextCharacters, i As Long
Set chars = ActiveShape.Text.Story.Characters
For i = 1 To chars.Count Step 2
  chars.Item(i).Fill.UniformColor.RGBAssign 255, 80, 0
Next
chars.First.Size = chars.First.Size * 2
